sections.title: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions

Properties

Parse

An array of allowed mention types. May contain "roles", "users", and/or "everyone". When null Discord falls back to its default behaviour. Mutually exclusive with / — if you specify individual IDs, do NOT list the corresponding type here.

Users

Up to 100 user IDs to mention. May only be used when does NOT contain "users".

Roles

Up to 100 role IDs to mention. May only be used when does NOT contain "roles".

RepliedUser

When true, pings the author of the message being replied to. Ignored on non-reply messages.

None

Suppresses all mentions — nothing in the message will ping anyone.

All

Allows all mention types (Discord's default).

PingRepliedUser

Pings only the author of a replied-to message; suppresses all other pings. Equivalent to new AllowedMentions { Parse = [], RepliedUser = true }.

OnlyRoles

Allows @role pings only.

OnlyUsers

Allows @user pings only.
